<script>
(function(){
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const cv=$('c'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const rand=(a,b)=>Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1))+a;
const rnd=()=>Math.random();
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const shuffle=a=>{for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=rand(0,i);[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a};
const EMOJI='"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Noto Color Emoji",sans-serif';
const FONT='"Baloo 2",system-ui,sans-serif';

/* ---------- từ vựng ---------- */
const B=(e,en,vi)=>({e,en,vi});
const banks={
  fruit:[B('🍎','apple','quả táo'),B('🍌','banana','quả chuối'),B('🍇','grape','quả nho'),B('🍓','strawberry','dâu tây'),B('🍊','orange','quả cam'),B('🍉','watermelon','dưa hấu'),B('🍍','pineapple','quả dứa'),B('🍒','cherry','anh đào'),B('🥭','mango','quả xoài'),B('🥥','coconut','quả dừa'),B('🍋','lemon','quả chanh'),B('🍑','peach','quả đào')],
  animal:[B('🐶','dog','con chó'),B('🐱','cat','con mèo'),B('🐘','elephant','con voi'),B('🦁','lion','sư tử'),B('🐵','monkey','con khỉ'),B('🐰','rabbit','con thỏ'),B('🐟','fish','con cá'),B('🐦','bird','con chim'),B('🐮','cow','con bò'),B('🐷','pig','con lợn'),B('🐢','turtle','con rùa'),B('🦒','giraffe','hươu cao cổ'),B('🐯','tiger','con hổ'),B('🐼','panda','gấu trúc')],
  object:[B('📚','book','quyển sách'),B('✏️','pencil','bút chì'),B('🎒','backpack','cái cặp'),B('⏰','clock','đồng hồ'),B('🏠','house','ngôi nhà'),B('🚗','car','ô tô'),B('⚽','ball','quả bóng'),B('🚲','bicycle','xe đạp'),B('☂️','umbrella','cái ô'),B('🌙','moon','mặt trăng'),B('⭐','star','ngôi sao'),B('🔑','key','chìa khóa'),B('🎈','balloon','bóng bay'),B('🎁','gift','món quà')]
};
banks.mix=[].concat(banks.fruit,banks.animal,banks.object);
(function(){
  const c=(window.EG&&window.EG.wordrush)||{},w=c.words||{};
  ['fruit','animal','object'].forEach(k=>{
    if(Array.isArray(w[k])){
      const l=w[k].filter(x=>x&&x.en&&String(x.en).trim()).map(x=>B(x.e||'❓',String(x.en).trim(),x.vi||''));
      if(l.length>=3)banks[k]=l;
    }
  });
  banks.mix=[].concat(banks.fruit,banks.animal,banks.object);
})();

/* ---------- trạng thái ---------- */
const CF=(window.EG&&window.EG.wordrush)||{};
const LIVES=CF.lives||3,LEVEL_EVERY=CF.levelEvery||6,SPEED_F=CF.speed||1;
let W=0,H=0,dpr=1,horizon=0,groundY=0,laneW=100;
let state='menu',topic='fruit',listen=false;
let score=0,lives=LIVES,level=1,combo=0,correctCnt=0,coinCnt=0,best=0;
let dist=0,speed=1.35,lane=0,pl=0,T=0,lastT=0,shake=0,flash=0,dustT=0;
let rows=[],coins=[],parts=[],trees=[],skyStars=[],lastItems=[],learned=[],missed=[],active=null;
const TREE_EMOJI=['🌴','🌳','🌲','🌴'];
const LANECOL=['#35E0FF','#FFD25E','#FF7AB6'];

/* ---------- âm thanh ---------- */
let AC=null,muted=false;
function tone(f,d,type,v,slide){
  if(muted)return;
  try{
    AC=AC||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const t=AC.currentTime,o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain();
    o.type=type||'sine';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t);
    if(slide)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40,f+slide),t+d);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(v||.15,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+d);
    o.connect(g);g.connect(AC.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+d);
  }catch(e){}
}
const sfx={
  move:()=>tone(320,.09,'sine',.06,240),
  coin:()=>tone(1250,.07,'square',.04),
  ok:()=>{tone(523,.12,'triangle',.15);setTimeout(()=>tone(784,.18,'triangle',.15),90)},
  bad:()=>tone(170,.32,'sawtooth',.12,-100),
  up:()=>{[523,659,784,1046].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>tone(f,.15,'triangle',.15),i*90))},
  over:()=>{[400,300,220,150].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>tone(f,.25,'sawtooth',.1),i*140))}
};
function speak(text){
  if(muted||!window.speechSynthesis)return;
  try{
    speechSynthesis.cancel();
    const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);u.lang='en-US';u.rate=.85;
    speechSynthesis.speak(u);
  }catch(e){}
}
$('mute').onclick=()=>{muted=!muted;$('mute').textContent=muted?'🔇':'🔊'};

/* ---------- kích thước ---------- */
function resize(){
  const r=$('app').getBoundingClientRect();
  dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  W=r.width;H=r.height;
  cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;cv.style.width=W+'px';cv.style.height=H+'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  horizon=H*.36;groundY=H*.84;laneW=Math.min(W*.29,150);
  skyStars=Array.from({length:40},()=>({x:rnd()*W,y:rnd()*horizon*.8,r:.4+rnd()*1.2,p:rnd()*6}));
}
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
function initTrees(){
  trees=[];
  for(let i=0;i<30;i++)trees.push({side:i%2?1:-1,x:2.0+rnd()*1.1,w:i*1.45+rnd()*.6,e:TREE_EMOJI[i%4]});
}

/* ---------- logic ---------- */
function pickItem(bank){
  let it,g=0;
  do{it=bank[rand(0,bank.length-1)]}while(lastItems.includes(it)&&g++<30);
  lastItems.push(it);if(lastItems.length>4)lastItems.shift();
  return it;
}
function spawnRow(){
  const bank=banks[topic];
  const item=pickItem(bank);
  const others=shuffle(bank.filter(x=>x!==item&&x.en!==item.en)).slice(0,2);
  const arr=shuffle([item,...others]);
  rows.push({z:8,items:arr,ci:arr.indexOf(item),item,judged:false,picked:null});
  if(rnd()<.85){
    const cl=rand(-1,1);
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++)coins.push({z:9.3+i*.42,lane:cl,got:false,ph:rnd()*6});
  }
  if(!active)setActive();
}
function setActive(){
  active=rows.find(r=>!r.judged)||null;
  const card=$('card');
  if(active){
    if(listen){$('cEmoji').textContent='🔊';$('cLabel').textContent='Nghe và chọn từ đúng';setTimeout(()=>{if(active)speak(active.item.en)},250)}
    else{$('cEmoji').textContent=active.item.e;$('cLabel').textContent='Đây là gì?'}
  }
  card.classList.remove('pulse');void card.offsetWidth;card.classList.add('pulse');
}
function startGame(t){
  topic=t;score=0;lives=LIVES;level=1;combo=0;correctCnt=0;coinCnt=0;speed=1.35*SPEED_F;lane=0;pl=0;
  rows=[];coins=[];parts=[];learned=[];missed=[];lastItems=[];active=null;
  $('start').classList.add('hidden');$('over').classList.add('hidden');
  state='play';spawnRow();hud();
  const h=$('hint');h.classList.remove('off');setTimeout(()=>h.classList.add('off'),5000);
}
function hud(){
  $('score').textContent=score;
  $('lvl').textContent='Cấp '+level;
  $('lives').textContent='❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0,lives))+'🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0,LIVES-Math.max(0,lives)));
  $('coins').textContent='🪙 '+coinCnt;
  $('lfill').style.width=((correctCnt%LEVEL_EVERY)/LEVEL_EVERY*100)+'%';
  const c=$('combo');
  if(combo>=2){c.textContent='Liên tiếp x'+combo+' 🔥';c.classList.add('on')}else c.classList.remove('on');
}
function say(el,t,cls){el.textContent=t;el.classList.remove('show');if(cls!==undefined)el.style.color=cls;void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('show')}
function burst(x,y,cols,n,g){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=rnd()*6.28,s=60+rnd()*260;
    parts.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s-120,life:.6+rnd()*.7,max:1.2,c:cols[rand(0,cols.length-1)],s:2+rnd()*4,g:g});
  }
}
function judge(r){
  r.judged=true;r.picked=lane;
  const ok=(lane+1)===r.ci,it=r.item;
  const px=W/2+lane*laneW,py=groundY-50;
  if(ok){
    combo++;correctCnt++;
    const mult=Math.min(4,1+Math.floor(combo/4));
    score+=10*mult;
    if(!learned.includes(it))learned.push(it);
    burst(px,py,['#FFD25E','#FF6B9D','#19D3A2','#35E0FF','#FFF4E6'],40,420);
    say($('toast'),it.e+' '+it.en+' = '+it.vi,'#3DF0B0');
    sfx.ok();if(!listen)setTimeout(()=>speak(it.en),150);
    if(correctCnt%LEVEL_EVERY===0){
      level++;speed=Math.min(3.3*SPEED_F,(1.35+(level-1)*.22)*SPEED_F);
      say($('banner'),'Cấp '+level+'!');sfx.up();
    }
  }else{
    combo=0;lives--;shake=.5;flash=1;
    if(!missed.includes(it))missed.push(it);
    burst(px,py,['#FF5C7A','#8F5AA8'],26,300);
    say($('toast'),'Đáp án: '+it.e+' '+it.en+' = '+it.vi,'#FFB0C0');
    sfx.bad();setTimeout(()=>speak(it.en),250);
  }
  hud();setActive();
  if(lives<=0)gameOver();
}
function gameOver(){
  state='over';sfx.over();best=Math.max(best,score);
  setTimeout(()=>{rows=[];coins=[];active=null},1200);
  setTimeout(()=>{
    $('fScore').textContent=score;$('fSolved').textContent=correctCnt;$('fLvl').textContent=level;$('fCoins').textContent=coinCnt;$('fBest').textContent=best;
    $('medal').textContent=score>=300?'Nhà thông thái tí hon! 🏆':score>=150?'Chạy xuất sắc! 🌟':score>=60?'Chạy giỏi lắm!':'Cố lên, thử lại nhé!';
    fill($('learned'),learned,'');fill($('missed'),missed,'miss');
    $('learnBox').style.display=learned.length?'block':'none';
    $('missBox').style.display=missed.length?'block':'none';
    $('over').classList.remove('hidden');
  },1000);
}
function fill(box,list,cls){
  box.textContent='';
  list.slice(0,8).forEach(it=>{
    const s=document.createElement('span');s.className='chip '+cls;s.textContent=it.e+' '+it.en+' · '+it.vi;box.appendChild(s);
  });
}
function move(d){
  if(state!=='play')return;
  const n=clamp(lane+d,-1,1);
  if(n!==lane){lane=n;sfx.move()}
}

function update(dt){
  const v=state==='play'?speed:state==='menu'?1.3:.6;
  dist+=v*dt;T+=dt;
  pl+=(lane-pl)*Math.min(1,dt*16);
  trees.forEach(t=>{if(t.w-dist<.45)t.w+=43.5});
  dustT-=dt;
  if(dustT<=0&&state!=='over'){
    dustT=.06;
    parts.push({x:W/2+pl*laneW+(rnd()-.5)*20,y:groundY+2,vx:(rnd()-.5)*40,vy:-20-rnd()*40,life:.4,max:.4,c:'rgba(255,220,180,.6)',s:3+rnd()*3,g:0});
  }
  if(state==='play'){
    rows.forEach(r=>r.z-=v*dt);coins.forEach(c=>c.z-=v*dt);
    const last=rows[rows.length-1];
    if(!last||last.z<=8-4.6)spawnRow();
    rows.forEach(r=>{if(!r.judged&&r.z<=1.0)judge(r)});
    coins.forEach(c=>{
      if(!c.got&&c.z<=1.06&&c.z>.7&&c.lane===lane){
        c.got=true;coinCnt++;score+=2;sfx.coin();
        burst(W/2+lane*laneW,groundY-45,['#FFD25E','#FFF4E6'],8,0);hud();
      }
    });
    rows=rows.filter(r=>r.z>.45);coins=coins.filter(c=>c.z>.45&&!c.got);
  }
  parts.forEach(p=>{p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=p.g*dt;p.life-=dt});
  parts=parts.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*1.4);flash=Math.max(0,flash-dt*2.2);
}

/* ---------- vẽ ---------- */
function rr(x,y,w,h,r){
  r=Math.min(r,w/2,h/2);
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);ctx.closePath();
}
function quad(zA,zB,xl,xr,col){
  const sA=1/zA,sB=1/zB,k=groundY-horizon;
  const yA=horizon+k*sA,yB=horizon+k*sB;
  ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W/2+xl*laneW*sA,yA);ctx.lineTo(W/2+xr*laneW*sA,yA);
  ctx.lineTo(W/2+xr*laneW*sB,yB);ctx.lineTo(W/2+xl*laneW*sB,yB);
  ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
}
function ridge(base,amp,seed,col,par){
  const ox=-pl*par;
  ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,horizon+2);
  for(let x=0;x<=W+10;x+=10){
    const xx=x+ox;
    const y=horizon-base-amp*((Math.sin(xx*.011+seed)*.5+.5)+.5*(Math.sin(xx*.027+seed*2.3)*.5+.5));
    ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W+10,horizon+2);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
}
function drawSky(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,horizon);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#170a3a');g.addColorStop(.45,'#5b21b6');g.addColorStop(.75,'#e0448e');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffb36b');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,horizon+2);
  skyStars.forEach(s=>{ctx.globalAlpha=.4+.5*Math.sin(T*2+s.p);ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill()});
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  const cx=W/2,cy=horizon-H*.03,r=Math.min(W*.2,112);
  const gl=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,r*.5,cx,cy,r*2.4);
  gl.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,190,110,.75)');gl.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,190,110,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=gl;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,horizon+2);
  ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,0,6.28);ctx.clip();
  const sg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,cy-r,0,cy+r);sg.addColorStop(0,'#FFE27A');sg.addColorStop(1,'#FF5C9D');
  ctx.fillStyle=sg;ctx.fillRect(cx-r,cy-r,r*2,r*2);
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++)ctx.fillRect(cx-r,cy+r*.02+i*r*.17,r*2,2+i*2.3);
  ctx.restore();
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const x=((i*W*.41+T*(6+i*3))%(W+240))-120,y=H*(.06+i*.045);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,190,220,'+(.16+i*.03)+')';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,50+i*8,10+i*2,0,0,6.28);ctx.ellipse(x+28,y-6,32,10,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  }
  ridge(6,H*.10,1.7,'#3a1c71',50);
  ridge(0,H*.06,4.1,'#24104f',90);
}
function drawGround(){
  const seg=1,base=dist%(2*seg),k0=.4;
  ctx.fillStyle='#124d33';ctx.fillRect(0,horizon,W,H-horizon);
  for(let k=-1;k<42;k++){
    const zA=Math.max(.35,k0+k*seg-base),zB=k0+(k+1)*seg-base;
    if(zB<=.36)continue;
    const odd=((k%2)+2)%2;
    quad(zA,zB,-60,60,odd?'#2a834f':'#2f8f57');
    quad(zA,zB,-1.5,1.5,odd?'#3b2f6b':'#43367a');
    const rc=odd?'#FF6B9D':'#FFF4E6';
    quad(zA,zB,-1.66,-1.5,rc);quad(zA,zB,1.5,1.66,rc);
    if(!odd){quad(zA,zB,-.53,-.47,'rgba(255,244,230,.8)');quad(zA,zB,.47,.53,'rgba(255,244,230,.8)')}
  }
  rows.forEach(r=>{
    if(r.z<.5)return;
    for(let l=-1;l<=1;l++){
      let c='rgba(255,255,255,.14)';
      if(r.judged&&(l+1)===r.ci)c='rgba(61,240,176,.5)';
      quad(r.z-.14,r.z+.14,l-.46,l+.46,c);
    }
  });
  const fg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,horizon-30,0,horizon+H*.15);
  fg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,160,120,0)');fg.addColorStop(.25,'rgba(255,150,120,.6)');fg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,150,120,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=fg;ctx.fillRect(0,horizon-30,W,H*.15+30);
}
function drawTree(t){
  const z=t.w-dist,s=1/z;
  const x=W/2+t.side*t.x*laneW*s,y=horizon+(groundY-horizon)*s;
  ctx.globalAlpha=clamp((42-z)/8,0,1);
  ctx.font=Math.round(150*s)+'px '+EMOJI;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='bottom';
  ctx.fillText(t.e,x,y+6*s);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function drawRow(r){
  const s=1/r.z,k=groundY-horizon,gy=horizon+k*s;
  for(let l=-1;l<=1;l++){
    const it=r.items[l+1],cx=W/2+l*laneW*s;
    const sw=laneW*.94*s,sh=66*s,top=gy-158*s;
    ctx.fillStyle='#7a4a2e';
    ctx.fillRect(cx-sw*.4-4*s,top+sh*.5,8*s,gy-top-sh*.5);
    ctx.fillRect(cx+sw*.4-4*s,top+sh*.5,8*s,gy-top-sh*.5);
    let fillc='#FFF4E6',tc='#2B1055';
    if(r.judged){
      if((l+1)===r.ci){fillc='#3DF0B0';tc='#053D2C'}
      else if(r.picked===l){fillc='#FF5C7A';tc='#fff'}
      else{fillc='#cfc6dc';tc='#6b5e86'}
    }
    ctx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.35)';ctx.shadowBlur=10*s;
    rr(cx-sw/2,top,sw,sh,14*s);ctx.fillStyle=fillc;ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.lineWidth=6*s;ctx.strokeStyle=LANECOL[l+1];ctx.stroke();
    let fs=30*s;ctx.font='800 '+fs+'px '+FONT;
    const tw=ctx.measureText(it.en).width;
    if(tw>sw*.84){fs*=sw*.84/tw;ctx.font='800 '+fs+'px '+FONT}
    ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillStyle=tc;
    ctx.fillText(it.en,cx,top+sh/2+2*s);
  }
}
function drawCoin(c){
  const s=1/c.z,x=W/2+c.lane*laneW*s,y=horizon+(groundY-horizon)*s-42*s;
  const w=Math.abs(Math.cos(T*4+c.ph))*14*s+2*s,h=14*s;
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFD25E';ctx.strokeStyle='#B98500';ctx.lineWidth=2*s;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,w,h,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.6)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x-w*.3,y-h*.3,w*.25,h*.3,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
}
function drawFox(){
  const sc=laneW/125,x=W/2+pl*laneW,y=groundY;
  const tilt=(lane-pl)*.32,run=Math.sin(T*13);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.32)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y+4,28*sc,8*sc,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(tilt);ctx.scale(sc,sc);
  ctx.translate(0,-Math.abs(run)*9);
  const OR='#FF8A3D',DK='#5a2d12';
  // chân
  ctx.fillStyle=DK;
  rr(-15,-14+(run>0?-8:0),11,16,4);ctx.fill();
  rr(4,-14+(run>0?0:-8),11,16,4);ctx.fill();
  // thân
  ctx.fillStyle=OR;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,-34,20,25,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFB07A';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,-30,11,16,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  // đuôi
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(0,-22);ctx.rotate(Math.sin(T*7)*.3);
  ctx.fillStyle=OR;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,-6,15,24,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFF4E6';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,-24,10,9,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  // đầu
  ctx.fillStyle=OR;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,-70,21,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-20,-76);ctx.lineTo(-13,-99);ctx.lineTo(-3,-84);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(20,-76);ctx.lineTo(13,-99);ctx.lineTo(3,-84);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle=DK;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-14,-80);ctx.lineTo(-12,-92);ctx.lineTo(-7,-83);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(14,-80);ctx.lineTo(12,-92);ctx.lineTo(7,-83);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#FFF4E6';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(-19,-64,5,7,.3,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(19,-64,5,7,-.3,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  // khăn
  const wv=Math.sin(T*10)*4;
  ctx.fillStyle='#35E0FF';
  rr(-19,-54,38,10,5);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(12,-50);ctx.lineTo(36+wv,-44);ctx.lineTo(32+wv,-36);ctx.lineTo(10,-44);ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}
function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0)ctx.translate((rnd()-.5)*shake*20,(rnd()-.5)*shake*20);
  drawSky();drawGround();
  const list=[];
  trees.forEach(t=>{const z=t.w-dist;if(z>.45&&z<42)list.push({z,f:()=>drawTree(t)})});
  rows.forEach(r=>{if(r.z>.5)list.push({z:r.z,f:()=>drawRow(r)})});
  coins.forEach(c=>{if(!c.got&&c.z>.5)list.push({z:c.z,f:()=>drawCoin(c)})});
  list.push({z:1,f:drawFox});
  list.sort((a,b)=>b.z-a.z);
  list.forEach(o=>o.f());
  parts.forEach(p=>{
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/p.max);ctx.fillStyle=p.c;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.s,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.restore();
  if(flash>0){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,60,90,'+flash*.3+')';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H)}
}
function loop(ts){
  const dt=Math.min(.05,(ts-lastT)/1000||0);lastT=ts;
  update(dt);draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

let sx=0,used=false,down=false;

@keyframes jmp{30%{transform:translateY(-26px) rotate(-8deg)}60%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(6deg)}}
#bubble{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:7px 14px;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;max-width:250px;margin-bottom:34px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
#bubble::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-8px;bottom:12px;border:8px solid transparent;border-left:0;border-right:10px solid #fff}

.overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:9;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:24px;text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(124,203,255,.96),rgba(189,233,255,.97));transition:opacity .3s;overflow-y:auto}
.overlay.hidden{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.logo{font-size:64px;animation:flt 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes flt{50%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(-5deg)}}
h1{font-size:46px;line-height:1;font-weight:800;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 4px 0 #3a86d6,0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.sub{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:#2f4d7a;max-width:300px;line-height:1.2}
.topics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;width:100%;max-width:330px}
.tp{border:0;border-radius:24px;padding:14px 8px 12px;font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:21px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 6px 0 var(--c);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;line-height:1}
.tp:active{transform:translateY(5px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--c)}
.tp .e{font-size:46px;font-family:"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Noto Color Emoji",sans-serif;margin-bottom:4px}
.tp small{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;opacity:.6;margin-top:2px}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:22px;padding:14px 26px;font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);background:var(--sun);box-shadow:0 6px 0 #d9a800;width:100%;max-width:300px}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(5px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #d9a800}
.btn.alt{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #9bb8d8}
.tp:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible,.rb:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}
.trophy{font-size:80px}
.bigstars{font-size:34px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 3px 0 #d9a800}
#eMsg{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#2f4d7a;max-width:300px;line-height:1.15}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.logo,.cloud,.string,.balloon.hint .body,#prompt.pulse,#bear.jump{animation:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">
  <div class="sunny"></div>
  <div class="cloud" style="top:16%;animation-duration:60s"></div>
  <div class="cloud" style="top:44%;animation-duration:90s;animation-delay:-40s;transform:scale(.7)"></div>
  <div class="hill h1"></div><div class="hill h2"></div>

  <div id="top">
    <div id="dots" aria-label="Tiến độ"></div>
    <button class="rb" id="voice" aria-label="Bật tắt giọng đọc">🗣️</button>
    <button class="rb" id="mute" aria-label="Bật tắt âm thanh">🔊</button>
  </div>

  <div id="prompt" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-live="polite"><div id="pTitle"></div><div id="pBig"></div><div id="pSub"></div></div>
  <div id="sky"></div>

  <div id="mascot"><div id="bear">🐻</div><div id="bubble">Chạm vào bong bóng nhé!</div></div>

  <div id="start" class="overlay">
    <div class="logo">🎈</div>
    <h1>Bóng Bay Vui</h1>
    <p class="sub">Chạm vào bong bóng đúng để làm nó nổ. Không sao nếu chạm sai, bé cứ thử lại!</p>
    <div class="topics">
      <button class="tp" data-t="num" style="--c:#FFB84D"><span class="e">🔢</span>Số<small>Tìm số</small></button>
      <button class="tp" data-t="count" style="--c:#FF7EB6"><span class="e">🍎</span>Đếm<small>Có mấy?</small></button>
      <button class="tp" data-t="letter" style="--c:#4ADE9B"><span class="e">🔤</span>Chữ cái<small>A B C</small></button>
      <button class="tp" data-t="color" style="--c:#A78BFA"><span class="e">🌈</span>Màu sắc<small>Tìm màu</small></button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="end" class="overlay hidden">
    <div class="trophy" id="eIcon">🏆</div>
    <div class="bigstars" id="eStars">⭐ 0/10</div>
    <div id="eMsg"></div>
    <button class="btn" id="again">Chơi lại</button>
    <button class="btn alt" id="menu">Chọn trò khác</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const rand=(a,b)=>Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1))+a;
const rnd=Math.random;
const shuffle=a=>{for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=rand(0,i);[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a};
const CF=(window.EG&&window.EG.bongbay)||{};
const TOTALQ=CF.totalQ||10;
const VN=['','một','hai','ba','bốn','năm','sáu','bảy','tám','chín','mười'];
const LETTERS=[['A','Áo','👕'],['B','Bóng','⚽'],['C','Cá','🐟'],['D','Dưa hấu','🍉'],['E','Em bé','👶'],['G','Gà','🐔'],['H','Hoa','🌸'],['K','Kem','🍦'],['L','Lá','🍃'],['M','Mèo','🐱'],['N','Nón','👒'],['O','Ong','🐝'],['S','Sao','⭐'],['T','Táo','🍎'],['V','Voi','🐘'],['X','Xe','🚗']];
const COLORS=[['đỏ','#FF5A5F'],['xanh dương','#3B82F6'],['xanh lá','#22C55E'],['vàng','#FACC15'],['cam','#FB923C'],['hồng','#F472B6'],['tím','#A855F7']];
const PAL=['#FF5A5F','#3B82F6','#22C55E','#FACC15','#FB923C','#F472B6','#A855F7','#14B8A6'];
const COUNTERS=['🍎','🐥','⭐','🐟','🚗','🌸','🎈','🍓'];
const PRAISE=['Giỏi quá!','Tuyệt vời!','Đúng rồi!','Hoan hô!','Bé thật thông minh!','Siêu quá!'];
const RETRY=['Ồ, thử lại nhé!','Gần đúng rồi, cố lên!','Bé thử bong bóng khác nào!'];
(function(){
  const rep=(arr,src,min,map)=>{if(Array.isArray(src)){const l=src.map(map).filter(Boolean);if(l.length>=min)arr.splice(0,arr.length,...l)}};
  rep(LETTERS,CF.letters,4,x=>x&&x.l?[String(x.l).trim().toUpperCase().slice(0,2),x.w||'',x.e||'']:null);
  rep(COLORS,CF.colors,4,x=>x&&x.n&&x.c?[String(x.n).trim(),x.c]:null);
  rep(COUNTERS,CF.counters,1,x=>x?String(x).trim():null);
  rep(PRAISE,CF.praise,1,x=>x?String(x).trim():null);
  rep(RETRY,CF.retry,1,x=>x?String(x).trim():null);
})();

let topic='num',qi=0,stars=0,wrong=0,cur=null,balloons=[],voiceOn=true,muted=false,used=new Set();
let W=0,H=0,T=0,lastT=0,qStart=0,hinted=false,locked=false;

/* ---------- âm thanh & giọng ---------- */
let AC=null;
function tone(f,d,type,v,slide){
  if(muted)return;
  try{
    AC=AC||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const t=AC.currentTime,o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain();
    o.type=type||'sine';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t);
    if(slide)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40,f+slide),t+d);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(v||.12,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+d);
    o.connect(g);g.connect(AC.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+d);
  }catch(e){}
}
const sfx={
  pop:()=>{tone(500,.09,'square',.08,-300);setTimeout(()=>tone(880,.08,'triangle',.1),40)},
  ok:()=>{[523,659,784].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>tone(f,.14,'triangle',.13),i*90))},
  boing:()=>tone(320,.22,'sine',.12,-120),
  fan:()=>{[523,659,784,1046,1318].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>tone(f,.18,'triangle',.13),i*100))}
};
function say(text){
  if(!voiceOn||muted||!window.speechSynthesis)return;
  try{speechSynthesis.cancel();const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);u.lang='vi-VN';u.rate=.9;u.pitch=1.15;speechSynthesis.speak(u)}catch(e){}
}
$('mute').onclick=()=>{muted=!muted;$('mute').textContent=muted?'🔇':'🔊'};
$('voice').onclick=()=>{voiceOn=!voiceOn;$('voice').classList.toggle('off',!voiceOn);if(voiceOn&&cur)say(cur.say)};

/* ---------- câu hỏi ---------- */
function unique(list,keyf){
  let it,g=0;
  do{it=list[rand(0,list.length-1)]}while(used.has(keyf(it))&&g++<40);
  used.add(keyf(it));return it;
}
function makeQ(){
  if(topic==='num'){
    const NR=Array.from({length:Math.min(10,Math.max(4,CF.maxNum||10))},(_,i)=>i+1);const n=unique(NR,x=>x);
    const others=shuffle(NR.filter(x=>x!==n)).slice(0,3);
    return{title:'Tìm số',big:String(n),sub:VN[n],say:'Tìm số '+VN[n],ans:String(n),
      opts:shuffle([n,...others]).map(x=>({id:String(x),label:String(x)}))};
  }
  if(topic==='count'){
    const max=qi<4?5:qi<7?7:9;
    const n=unique(Array.from({length:max},(_,i)=>i+1),x=>x);
    const e=COUNTERS[rand(0,COUNTERS.length-1)];
    const pool=[];for(let d=1;d<=10;d++)if(d!==n)pool.push(d);
    pool.sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a-n)-Math.abs(b-n)||rnd()-.5);
    const others=pool.slice(0,3);
    return{title:'Đếm xem có mấy?',big:e.repeat(n),emo:true,sub:'Chạm bong bóng có số đúng',say:'Đếm xem có mấy?',ans:String(n),
      opts:shuffle([n,...others]).map(x=>({id:String(x),label:String(x)}))};
  }
  if(topic==='letter'){
    const L=unique(LETTERS,x=>x[0]);
    const others=shuffle(LETTERS.filter(x=>x!==L)).slice(0,3);
    return{title:'Tìm chữ cái',big:L[0]+' '+L[0].toLowerCase(),sub:L[0]+' của '+L[1]+' '+L[2],say:'Tìm chữ '+L[0]+'. '+L[0]+' của '+L[1],ans:L[0],
      opts:shuffle([L,...others]).map(x=>({id:x[0],label:x[0]}))};
  }
  const C=unique(COLORS,x=>x[0]);
  const others=shuffle(COLORS.filter(x=>x!==C)).slice(0,3);
  return{title:'Tìm bóng màu',big:C[0].toUpperCase(),color:C[1],col:true,sub:'Chạm bong bóng màu '+C[0],say:'Tìm bóng màu '+C[0],ans:C[0],
    opts:shuffle([C,...others]).map(x=>({id:x[0],label:'',color:x[1]}))};
}

/* ---------- bong bóng ---------- */
function measure(){const r=$('app').getBoundingClientRect();W=r.width;H=r.height}
function clearBalloons(){balloons.forEach(b=>b.el.remove());balloons=[]}
function spawn(q){
  clearBalloons();
  const bw=Math.min(96,W*.21),bh=bw*1.2;
  const lanes=shuffle([0,1,2,3]);
  const colors=shuffle(PAL.slice());
  q.opts.forEach((o,i)=>{
    const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='balloon';
    const col=o.color||colors[i];
    el.innerHTML='<div class="body" style="--c:'+col+';width:'+bw+'px;height:'+bh+'px;font-size:'+(bw*.52)+'px"></div><div class="string"></div>';
    el.querySelector('.body').textContent=o.label;
    $('sky').appendChild(el);
    const b={el,id:o.id,bw,bh,bx:W*(lanes[i]+.5)/4-bw/2,y:H*.5+i*74+rand(0,40),v:rand(46,66)*(CF.speed||1),f:.9+rnd()*.8,ph:rnd()*6};
    el.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();tap(b)});
    balloons.push(b);
  });
}
function burst(x,y,cols){
  for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
    const s=document.createElement('i');s.className='spark';
    const sz=6+rnd()*8;s.style.cssText='left:'+x+'px;top:'+y+'px;width:'+sz+'px;height:'+sz+'px;background:'+cols[i%cols.length];
    $('app').appendChild(s);
    const a=rnd()*6.28,d=50+rnd()*90;
    s.animate([{transform:'translate(0,0) scale(1)',opacity:1},{transform:'translate('+Math.cos(a)*d+'px,'+(Math.sin(a)*d+30)+'px) scale(.3)',opacity:0}],{duration:600+rnd()*300,easing:'ease-out'}).onfinish=()=>s.remove();
  }
}
function bubble(t){$('bubble').textContent=t}
function jump(){const b=$('bear');b.classList.remove('jump');void b.offsetWidth;b.classList.add('jump')}

function tap(b){
  if(locked||!cur)return;
  if(b.id===cur.ans){
    locked=true;
    const cs=getComputedStyle(b.el.querySelector('.body')).getPropertyValue('--c').trim()||'#fff';
    const cx=b.x+b.bw/2,cy=b.y+b.bh/2;
    burst(cx,cy,[cs,'#FFD93D','#fff']);
    sfx.pop();b.el.remove();
    balloons.forEach(o=>{if(o!==b)o.el.classList.add('away')});
    const first=(wrong===0);
    if(first)stars++;
    markDot(first);
    const p=PRAISE[rand(0,PRAISE.length-1)];bubble(p);jump();
    setTimeout(()=>{sfx.ok();say(p)},120);
    qi++;
    setTimeout(()=>{if(qi>=TOTALQ)finish();else next()},1400);
  }else{
    wrong++;b.el.classList.remove('shake');void b.el.offsetWidth;b.el.classList.add('shake');
    sfx.boing();bubble(RETRY[rand(0,RETRY.length-1)]);
    if(wrong>=(CF.hintAfter||2))showHint();
  }
}
function showHint(){
  if(hinted)return;hinted=true;
  const c=balloons.find(b=>b.id===cur.ans);if(c)c.el.classList.add('hint');
  bubble('Bé nhìn bong bóng đang sáng nhé!');
}

/* ---------- vòng chơi ---------- */
function buildDots(){
  const d=$('dots');d.innerHTML='';
  for(let i=0;i<TOTALQ;i++){const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='dot';d.appendChild(e)}
}
function markDot(star){
  const e=$('dots').children[qi];if(!e)return;
  e.className='dot '+(star?'star':'done');e.textContent=star?'⭐':'✓';
}
function updateDots(){
  [...$('dots').children].forEach((e,i)=>{if(i===qi)e.classList.add('now');else e.classList.remove('now')});
}
function showPrompt(q){
  $('pTitle').textContent=q.title;
  const big=$('pBig');big.textContent=q.big;big.className=q.emo?'emo':q.col?'col':'';big.style.color=q.col?q.color:'';
  $('pSub').textContent=q.sub;
  const p=$('prompt');p.classList.remove('pulse');void p.offsetWidth;p.classList.add('pulse');
}
function next(){
  cur=makeQ();wrong=0;hinted=false;locked=false;qStart=T;
  showPrompt(cur);spawn(cur);updateDots();
  bubble(qi===0?'Chạm vào bong bóng nhé!':'Câu tiếp theo nào!');
  say(cur.say);
}
function start(t){
  topic=t;qi=0;stars=0;used=new Set();
  $('start').classList.add('hidden');$('end').classList.add('hidden');
  measure();buildDots();next();
}
function finish(){
  clearBalloons();cur=null;sfx.fan();
  $('eStars').textContent='⭐ '+stars+'/'+TOTALQ;
  let m,ic;
  if(stars>=9){m='Tuyệt đỉnh! Bé giỏi hết sức!';ic='🏆'}
  else if(stars>=6){m='Giỏi quá! Bé làm rất tốt!';ic='🌟'}
  else{m='Bé đã cố gắng rất nhiều! Chơi lại để được nhiều sao hơn nhé!';ic='💪'}
  $('eMsg').textContent=m;$('eIcon').textContent=ic;say(m);
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++)setTimeout(()=>burst(W*(.25+i*.25),H*.3,['#FFD93D','#FF7EB6','#4ADE9B','#5AB8FF']),i*250);
  $('end').classList.remove('hidden');
}

/* ---------- vòng lặp ---------- */
function loop(ts){
  const dt=Math.min(.05,(ts-lastT)/1000||0);lastT=ts;T+=dt;
  balloons.forEach(b=>{
    if(b.el.classList.contains('away'))return;
    b.y-=b.v*dt;
    const x=b.bx+Math.sin(T*b.f+b.ph)*12;
    b.x=x;
    if(b.y<-(b.bh+80))b.y=H-40+rand(0,80);
    b.el.style.transform='translate3d('+x+'px,'+b.y+'px,0) rotate('+Math.sin(T*b.f+b.ph)*4+'deg)';
  });
  if(cur&&!hinted&&!locked&&T-qStart>(CF.hintSec||12))showHint();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

$('prompt').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(cur)say(cur.say)});
$('prompt').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if((e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')&&cur)say(cur.say)});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>start(b.dataset.t)));
$('again').onclick=()=>start(topic);
$('menu').onclick=()=>{$('end').classList.add('hidden');$('start').classList.remove('hidden');clearBalloons();cur=null;$('pTitle').textContent='';$('pBig').textContent='';$('pSub').textContent=''};
window.addEventListener('resize',measure);
measure();buildDots();requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Ninja Vượt Chướng Ngại</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;600;700&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --paper: #FBF7EE;
            --ink: #20283A;
            --teal: #1B998B;
            --ticket: #E4572E;
            --gold: #F4B942;
            --shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
        }
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        body {
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1D2E4A 0%, #16233A 60%, #0F172A 100%);
            color: #fff;
            height: 100vh;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            user-select: none;
        }

        /* HEADER */
        .header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 6px 16px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .06);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            height: 50px;
            flex-wrap: nowrap;
        }
        .header .icon {
            font-size: 24px;
        }
        .header .title {
            font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--gold);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .header .stats {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-left: auto;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .6);
            flex-wrap: nowrap;
        }
        .header .stat {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .07);
            padding: 2px 10px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .header .stat .num {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #fff;
            min-width: 18px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .btn-icon {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .07);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50%;
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            font-size: 16px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: .15s;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: #fff;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .btn-icon:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .15);
        }
        .btn-icon.shop-btn {
            background: rgba(244, 185, 66, .15);
            color: var(--gold);
            font-size: 17px;
        }
        .btn-icon.shop-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(244, 185, 66, .3);
        }
        .btn-quit {
            font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
            font-size: 11px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .15);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 4px 14px;
            background: transparent;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all .15s;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .5);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .btn-quit:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* MAIN */
        .main {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 14px 16px 16px;
            gap: 14px;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        /* SCENE */
        .scene-wrap {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 660px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .scene {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            height: 130px;
            border-radius: 18px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1F3255 0%, #142238 100%);
            box-shadow: inset 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3);
        }
        .scene-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 80%, rgba(27, 153, 139, .07), transparent 60%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .ground {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            height: 26px;
            background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(244, 185, 66, .25) 0 20px, transparent 20px 40px);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(244, 185, 66, .12);
        }
        .ground-line {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 26px;
            height: 1px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .04);
        }

        /* Progress bar on scene */
        .progress-track {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 32px;
            left: 12px;
            right: 12px;
            height: 4px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .progress-fill {
            height: 100%;
            width: 0%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--teal));
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        }
        .progress-label {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 38px;
            right: 12px;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .3);
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        /* NINJA */
        .ninja {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 26px;
            font-size: 40px;
            z-index: 10;
            transition: left 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), transform 0.2s;
            left: 4%;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4));
            transform-origin: bottom center;
        }
        .ninja.run {
            animation: runAnim 0.25s ease-in-out 3;
        }
        .ninja.jump {
            animation: jumpAnim 0.5s ease;
        }
        .ninja.attack {
            animation: attackAnim 0.4s ease;
        }
        @keyframes runAnim {
            0%,
            100% {
                transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg);
            }
            50% {
                transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(-3deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes jumpAnim {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
            }
            40% {
                transform: translateY(-40px) scale(0.9);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
            }
        }
        @keyframes attackAnim {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
            }
            30% {
                transform: rotate(-15deg) scale(1.15);
            }
            60% {
                transform: rotate(10deg) scale(1.1);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
            }
        }

        /* DESTINATION */
        .destination {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 26px;
            right: 2%;
            font-size: 34px;
            z-index: 5;
            opacity: 0.7;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 10px rgba(244, 185, 66, .2));
            transition: opacity 0.5s;
        }
        .destination.reached {
            opacity: 1;
            animation: flagWave 0.6s ease-in-out 3;
        }
        @keyframes flagWave {
            0%,
            100% {
                transform: rotate(0deg);
            }
            50% {
                transform: rotate(8deg);
            }
        }

        /* OBSTACLES */
        .obstacle {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 26px;
            font-size: 24px;
            opacity: 0.5;
            z-index: 4;
            transition: opacity 0.4s;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3));
        }
        .obstacle.hit {
            opacity: 0.2;
            animation: shake 0.3s ease;
        }
        @keyframes shake {
            0%,
            100% {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
            25% {
                transform: translateX(-6px);
            }
            75% {
                transform: translateX(6px);
            }
        }

        /* ENEMIES */
        .enemy {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 26px;
            font-size: 30px;
            z-index: 6;
            transition: opacity 0.5s, transform 0.5s;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(228, 87, 46, .2));

        .enemy .hp-bar {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 34px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);

            height: 4px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .15);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;

        .enemy .hp-fill {
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--ticket);
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: width 0.3s;

        .enemy .enemy-label {

            bottom: 40px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);

            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
            padding: 0 6px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;

        .enemy:hover .enemy-label {
            opacity: 1;
        }
        .enemy.defeated {
            opacity: 0.15;
            transform: scale(0.6) rotate(20deg);
        }
        .enemy.alert {
            animation: enemyAlert 0.5s ease 2;

        @keyframes enemyAlert {

            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            50% {

        .q-header .q-num {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);

            border-radius: 12px;
        }
        .q-header .q-timer {

            gap: 4px;
        }
        .q-content {

        .options {

        .option-btn:disabled {

        .option-btn .letter {

        .option-btn.wrong {

        .option-btn.wrong .letter {

        }
        .option-btn.dimmed {

        }

            font-size: 15px;
            text-align: center;

        .feedback.correct {

        }
        .feedback.wrong {
            color: var(--ticket);
        }

            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            color: var(--ink);
        }

        .overlay {

            padding: 20px;
        }
        .overlay.active {
            display: flex;
        }
        .overlay-card {
            background: #fff;

        }

            font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
            font-size: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;

        }

            font-size: 13px;
            color: #888;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
        }
        .shop-items {
            display: flex;

        }

        .shop-item .emoji {
            font-size: 28px;
            width: 40px;
            text-align: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .shop-item .info {
            flex: 1;
        }
        .shop-item .info .name {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 14px;
        }
        .shop-item .info .desc {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #888;
        }
        .shop-item .info .owned {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--teal);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .shop-item .price {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold);
        }
        .shop-item .btn-buy {
            padding: 5px 16px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;

            font-weight: 700;

            transition: .15s;
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

            transform: scale(1.04);

            margin-top: 4px;

            color: var(--gold);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 18px;
        }
        .btn-close-shop {

            padding: 10px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
            font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 14px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: .15s;
            color: #666;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }
        .btn-close-shop:hover {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
        }

        .overlay-card.gameover {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 360px;
        }
        .overlay-card.gameover h2 {
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 24px;
        }
        .overlay-card .final-score {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 40px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold);
            margin: 8px 0;
        }
        .overlay-card .final-detail {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #888;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        .overlay-card .btn-back {
            padding: 10px 32px;
            background: var(--teal);
            color: #fff;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 14px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: .15s;
        }

            transform: scale(1.04);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(27, 153, 139, .3);
        }

            from {

                transform: scale(.92) translateY(12px);

                transform: scale(1) translateY(0);

            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

            <div class="sub">Dùng điểm ⭐ để mua vũ khí đánh bại kẻ địch</div>
            <div class="shop-items" id="shopItems"></div>
            <div class="shop-total">Điểm: <span id="shopPoints">0</span> ⭐</div>
            <button class="btn-close-shop" id="btnCloseShop">Đóng</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- GAME OVER OVERLAY -->
    <div class="overlay" id="gameOverOverlay">
        <div class="overlay-card gameover">
            <h2>🎉 Hoàn thành!</h2>
            <div class="final-score" id="finalScore">0</div>
            <div class="final-detail" id="finalDetail">Thời gian: 0s · Đúng: 0/0</div>
            <button class="btn-back" id="btnBack">Quay lại</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        (function() {
            'use strict';

            // ─── STATE ──────────────────────────────────────────────
            var questions = [];
            var currentIdx = 0;
            var score = 0;
            var correctCount = 0;
            var startTime = 0;
            var timeLeft = 15;
            var timerInterval = null;
            var answered = false;

            // Progress: 0..1
            var progress = 0;
            var totalQuestions = 0;
            var stepPerQuestion = 0;

            // Enemies
            var enemies = [];
            // Each enemy: { pos: 0..1, icon, label, defeated: bool, hp: 1 }
            var enemyConfigs = [
                { pos: 0.20, icon: '🦹', label: 'Bandit' },
                { pos: 0.40, icon: '👹', label: 'Oni' },
                { pos: 0.60, icon: '🐉', label: 'Dragon' },
                { pos: 0.80, icon: '🧟', label: 'Zombie' }
            ];

            // Inventory: { shuriken, katana, bomb, shield }
            var inventory = {
                shuriken: 0,
                katana: 0,
                bomb: 0,
                shield: 0
            };

            // Shop items
            var shopItems = [
                { id: 'shuriken', icon: '🗡️', name: 'Shuriken', desc: 'Đánh bại 1 kẻ địch', price: 5 },
                { id: 'katana', icon: '⚔️', name: 'Katana', desc: 'Đánh bại 2 kẻ địch', price: 10 },
                { id: 'bomb', icon: '💣', name: 'Bom', desc: 'Đánh bại TẤT CẢ kẻ địch', price: 18 },
                { id: 'shield', icon: '🛡️', name: 'Khiên', desc: 'Chặn 1 chướng ngại vật', price: 8 }
            ];

            var ninjaEl = document.getElementById('ninja');
            var sceneEl = document.getElementById('scene');
            var sceneLabel = document.getElementById('sceneLabel');
            var sceneStatus = document.getElementById('sceneStatus');
            var progressFill = document.getElementById('progressFill');
            var progressLabel = document.getElementById('progressLabel');
            var destinationEl = document.getElementById('destination');
            var qContent = document.getElementById('qContent');
            var qOptions = document.getElementById('qOptions');
            var qNum = document.getElementById('qNum');
            var qTimer = document.getElementById('qTimer');
            var scoreDisplay = document.getElementById('scoreDisplay');
            var feedback = document.getElementById('feedback');
            var explanationArea = document.getElementById('explanationArea');
            var shopOverlay = document.getElementById('shopOverlay');
            var shopItemsEl = document.getElementById('shopItems');
            var shopPoints = document.getElementById('shopPoints');
            var gameOverOverlay = document.getElementById('gameOverOverlay');
            var finalScore = document.getElementById('finalScore');
            var finalDetail = document.getElementById('finalDetail');
            var invDisplay = document.getElementById('invDisplay');
            var invDisplay2 = document.getElementById('invDisplay2');

            var obstacleIcons = ['🌵', '🪨', '🔥', '🧱'];

            // ─── HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────────────
            function updateInventoryUI() {
                var total = inventory.shuriken + inventory.katana + inventory.bomb + inventory.shield;
                if (total === 0) {
                    invDisplay.textContent = '🗡️0';
                    invDisplay2.style.display = 'none';
                    return;
                }
                var parts = [];
                if (inventory.shuriken > 0) parts.push('🗡️' + inventory.shuriken);
                if (inventory.katana > 0) parts.push('⚔️' + inventory.katana);
                if (inventory.bomb > 0) parts.push('💣' + inventory.bomb);
                if (inventory.shield > 0) parts.push('🛡️' + inventory.shield);
                if (parts.length <= 2) {
                    invDisplay.textContent = parts.join(' ');
                    invDisplay2.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    invDisplay.textContent = parts.slice(0, 2).join(' ');
                    invDisplay2.style.display = 'inline';
                    invDisplay2.textContent = ' +' + (parts.length - 2) + ' more';
                }
                // Update badge tooltip
                var detail = parts.map(function(p) { return p; }).join(' · ');
                document.getElementById('invBadge').title = 'Kho đồ: ' + detail;
            }

            function getTotalWeapons() {
                return inventory.shuriken + inventory.katana + inventory.bomb + inventory.shield;
            }

            function useWeapon() {
                // Use the most "powerful" weapon first: bomb > katana > shuriken
                if (inventory.bomb > 0) { inventory.bomb--; return '💣'; }
                if (inventory.katana > 0) { inventory.katana--; return '⚔️'; }
                if (inventory.shuriken > 0) { inventory.shuriken--; return '🗡️'; }
                return null;
            }

            function countWeapons() {
                return inventory.shuriken + inventory.katana + inventory.bomb + inventory.shield;
            }

            function hasWeapon() {
                return countWeapons() > 0;
            }

            // ─── RENDER SCENE ──────────────────────────────────────
            function renderScene() {
                // Ninja position: from 4% to 88%
                var left = 4 + progress * 84;
                ninjaEl.style.left = left + '%';
                progressFill.style.width = (progress * 100) + '%';
                progressLabel.textContent = Math.round(progress * 100) + '%';
                sceneLabel.textContent = '🏁 ' + Math.round(progress * 100) + '%';

                // Destination pulse
                if (progress >= 0.99) {
                    destinationEl.classList.add('reached');
                } else {
                    destinationEl.classList.remove('reached');
                }

                // Enemies
                var existing = sceneEl.querySelectorAll('.enemy');
                existing.forEach(function(e) { e.remove(); });

                enemies.forEach(function(en) {
                    if (en.defeated) return;
                    var el = document.createElement('div');
                    el.className = 'enemy';
                    el.style.left = (4 + en.pos * 84) + '%';
                    el.innerHTML = en.icon +
                        '<div class="hp-bar"><div class="hp-fill" style="width:' + (en.hp / en.maxHp * 100) +
                        '%"></div></div>' +
                        '<span class="enemy-label">' + en.label + '</span>';
                    el.dataset.enemyIdx = enemies.indexOf(en);
                    sceneEl.appendChild(el);
                });

                // Obstacles (only show some)
                var obsExisting = sceneEl.querySelectorAll('.obstacle');
                obsExisting.forEach(function(o) { o.remove(); });
                // Show 3-4 obstacles at random positions, but only if progress > 0.05
                if (progress > 0.05) {
                    var count = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2);
                    var positions = [];
                    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                        var p = 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.84;
                        // Avoid enemy positions
                        var tooClose = false;
                        enemies.forEach(function(en) {
                            if (Math.abs(p - en.pos) < 0.06) tooClose = true;
                        });
                        if (tooClose) p = (p + 0.1) % 0.9;
                        positions.push(p);
                    }
                    positions.forEach(function(p) {
                        var obs = document.createElement('span');
                        obs.className = 'obstacle';
                        obs.textContent = obstacleIcons[Math.floor(Math.random() * obstacleIcons.length)];
                        obs.style.left = (4 + p * 84) + '%';
                        sceneEl.appendChild(obs);
                    });
                }

                // Update status
                var alive = enemies.filter(function(e) { return !e.defeated; }).length;
                sceneStatus.textContent = '⚔️ ' + alive + ' kẻ địch';
                updateInventoryUI();
            }

            // ─── ENEMY ENCOUNTER ──────────────────────────────────
            function checkEnemyEncounter() {
                // Check if ninja has reached any alive enemy position
                for (var i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
                    var en = enemies[i];
                    if (en.defeated) continue;
                    var diff = Math.abs(progress - en.pos);
                    if (diff < 0.025) {
                        // Encounter!
                        encounterEnemy(en);
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                return false;
            }

            function encounterEnemy(en) {
                // Pause timer
                clearInterval(timerInterval);

                // Visual alert
                var enemyEls = sceneEl.querySelectorAll('.enemy');
                enemyEls.forEach(function(el) {
                    var idx = parseInt(el.dataset.enemyIdx);
                    if (idx === enemies.indexOf(en)) {
                        el.classList.add('alert');
                    }
                });

                // Check if player has weapon
                var weapon = useWeapon();
                if (weapon) {
                    // Defeat enemy
                    en.defeated = true;
                    var bonus = 5;
                    score += bonus;
                    scoreDisplay.textContent = score;
                    feedback.textContent = '⚔️ Dùng ' + weapon + ' đánh bại ' + en.label + '! +' + bonus + ' điểm';
                    feedback.className = 'feedback weapon';
                    // Ninja attack animation
                    ninjaEl.classList.add('attack');
                    setTimeout(function() { ninjaEl.classList.remove('attack'); }, 400);
                    renderScene();
                    // Continue after delay
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        resumeAfterEncounter();
                    }, 1000);
                } else {
                    // No weapon - take damage
                    var penalty = 5;
                    score = Math.max(0, score - penalty);
                    scoreDisplay.textContent = score;
                    feedback.textContent = '💥 Không có vũ khí! ' + en.label + ' tấn công! -' + penalty + ' điểm';
                    feedback.className = 'feedback enemy';
                    // Push back slightly
                    progress = Math.max(0, progress - 0.04);
                    renderScene();
                    // Enemy still there (not defeated)
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        resumeAfterEncounter();
                    }, 1200);
                }
            }

            function resumeAfterEncounter() {
                // Continue the game
                if (currentIdx >= questions.length) {
                    endGame();
                    return;
                }
                answered = false;
                renderScene();
                startTimer(questions[currentIdx]);
            }

            // ─── QUESTIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────
            function renderQuestion() {
                if (currentIdx >= questions.length) {
                    endGame();
                    return;
                }
                answered = false;
                var q = questions[currentIdx];
                qContent.textContent = q.content;
                qNum.textContent = 'Câu ' + (currentIdx + 1) + '/' + questions.length;
                scoreDisplay.textContent = score;

                feedback.textContent = '';
                feedback.className = 'feedback';
                explanationArea.innerHTML = '';

                var LETTERS = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'];
                qOptions.innerHTML = '';
                q.options.forEach(function(o, i) {
                    var btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'option-btn';
                    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="letter">' + LETTERS[i] + '</span><span>' + o.content +
                        '</span>';
                    btn.onclick = function() { selectAnswer(o.id, q); };
                    qOptions.appendChild(btn);
                });

                timeLeft = q.timeLimit || 15;
                qTimer.textContent = timeLeft;
                startTimer(q);
                renderScene();

                // Check if ninja is already at an enemy position (from previous progress)
                // But we handle this in the timer loop
            }

            function startTimer(q) {
                clearInterval(timerInterval);
                timerInterval = setInterval(function() {
                    timeLeft--;
                    qTimer.textContent = Math.max(0, timeLeft);
                    if (timeLeft <= 0) {
                        clearInterval(timerInterval);
                        if (!answered) selectAnswer(null, q);
                    }
                }, 1000);
            }

            function selectAnswer(answerId, q) {
                if (answered) return;
                answered = true;
                clearInterval(timerInterval);

                var btns = Array.from(qOptions.querySelectorAll('.option-btn'));
                btns.forEach(function(b) { b.disabled = true; });

                if (answerId !== null && typeof window.apiSubmitAnswer === 'function') {
                    window.apiSubmitAnswer(q.id, answerId)
                        .then(function(raw) {
                            var res = raw && raw.data ? raw.data : raw;
                            processResult(res.correct, res.points, q, answerId, res.correctAnswer);
                        })
                        .catch(function() {
                            processResult(false, 0, q, answerId, null);
                        });
                } else {
                    // Fallback: check against correctAnswerId
                    var isCorrect = (answerId === q.correctAnswerId);
                    processResult(isCorrect, isCorrect ? 10 : 0, q, answerId, q.correctAnswerId);
                }
            }

            function processResult(isCorrect, earnedPoints, q, answerId, correctAnswerId) {
                var btns = Array.from(qOptions.querySelectorAll('.option-btn'));
                btns.forEach(function(b) {
                    var text = b.querySelector('span:last-child').textContent;
                    var matching = q.options.find(function(o) { return o.content === text; });
                    if (!matching) return;
                    if (matching.id === correctAnswerId) b.classList.add('correct');
                    if (matching.id === answerId && !isCorrect) b.classList.add('wrong');
                    if (matching.id !== correctAnswerId && matching.id !== answerId) b.classList.add('dimmed');
                });

                var timeBonus = 0;
                if (isCorrect) {
                    timeBonus = Math.round((timeLeft / (q.timeLimit || 15)) * 30);
                    var totalEarned = (earnedPoints || 10) + timeBonus;
                    score += totalEarned;
                    correctCount++;
                    scoreDisplay.textContent = score;

                    // Move ninja forward
                    progress = Math.min(1, progress + stepPerQuestion);
                    ninjaEl.classList.add('run');
                    setTimeout(function() { ninjaEl.classList.remove('run'); }, 700);
                    ninjaEl.classList.add('jump');
                    setTimeout(function() { ninjaEl.classList.remove('jump'); }, 500);

                    feedback.textContent = '✅ Chính xác! +' + totalEarned + ' điểm 🥷';
                    feedback.className = 'feedback correct';

                    // Check if enemy encountered
                    var hasEncounter = checkEnemyEncounter();
                    if (hasEncounter) {
                        // Enemy encounter handled in checkEnemyEncounter
                        renderScene();
                        return;
                    }

                } else if (answerId === null) {
                    feedback.textContent = '⏰ Hết giờ! Va phải chướng ngại!';
                    feedback.className = 'feedback timeout';
                    progress = Math.max(0, progress - 0.03);
                } else {
                    feedback.textContent = '❌ Sai rồi! Va phải chướng ngại!';
                    feedback.className = 'feedback wrong';
                    progress = Math.max(0, progress - 0.03);
                }

                if (q.explanation) {
                    explanationArea.innerHTML = '<div class="explanation">💡 <b>Giải thích:</b> ' + q.explanation +
                        '</div>';
                }

                renderScene();

                setTimeout(function() {
                    currentIdx++;
                    renderQuestion();
                }, 1600);
            }

            // ─── END GAME ──────────────────────────────────────────
            function endGame() {
                clearInterval(timerInterval);
                var timeUsed = Math.round((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000);
                finalScore.textContent = score + ' điểm';
                var alive = enemies.filter(function(e) { return !e.defeated; }).length;
                var detail = '⏱ ' + timeUsed + 's  ·  ✅ ' + correctCount + '/' + questions.length + ' đúng';
                if (alive > 0) detail += '  ·  👹 ' + alive + ' kẻ địch còn sống';
                finalDetail.textContent = detail;
                gameOverOverlay.classList.add('active');
                setTimeout(function() {
                    parent.postMessage({
                        type: 'game-over',
                        data: {
                            score: score,
                            correct: correctCount,
                            totalQuestions: questions.length,
                            timeUsed: timeUsed
                        }
                    }, '*');
                }, 1300);
            }

            // ─── SHOP ──────────────────────────────────────────────
            function openShop() {
                renderShop();
                shopOverlay.classList.add('active');
            }

            function closeShop() {
                shopOverlay.classList.remove('active');
            }

            function renderShop() {
                shopPoints.textContent = score;
                shopItemsEl.innerHTML = '';
                shopItems.forEach(function(item) {
                    var owned = inventory[item.id] || 0;
                    var div = document.createElement('div');
                    div.className = 'shop-item';
                    var canBuy = score >= item.price;
                    div.innerHTML =
                        '<span class="emoji">' + item.icon + '</span>' +
                        '<div class="info">' +
                        '<div class="name">' + item.name + '</div>' +
                        '<div class="desc">' + item.desc + '</div>' +
                        '<div class="owned">' + (owned > 0 ? 'Sở hữu: ' + owned : '') + '</div>' +
                        '</div>' +
                        '<span class="price">' + item.price + '⭐</span>' +
                        '<button class="btn-buy" ' + (canBuy ? '' : 'disabled') + ' data-id="' + item.id +
                        '">Mua</button>';
                    shopItemsEl.appendChild(div);
                });

                shopItemsEl.querySelectorAll('.btn-buy').forEach(function(btn) {
                    btn.onclick = function() {
                        var id = this.dataset.id;
                        var item = shopItems.find(function(i) { return i.id === id; });
                        if (!item) return;
                        if (score < item.price) return;
                        score -= item.price;
                        inventory[id] = (inventory[id] || 0) + 1;
                        scoreDisplay.textContent = score;
                        renderShop();
                        renderScene();
                        updateInventoryUI();
                        feedback.textContent = '🛒 Mua ' + item.icon + ' ' + item.name + ' thành công!';
                        feedback.className = 'feedback weapon';
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            if (feedback.className === 'feedback weapon') {
                                feedback.textContent = '';
                                feedback.className = 'feedback';
                            }
                        }, 2000);
                    };
                });
            }

            // ─── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────
            function initGame(data) {
                questions = data.questions || [];
                totalQuestions = questions.length;
                stepPerQuestion = totalQuestions > 0 ? 1 / totalQuestions : 0.05;

                // Reset state
                currentIdx = 0;
                score = 0;
                correctCount = 0;
                progress = 0;
                answered = false;
                startTime = Date.now();
                inventory = { shuriken: 0, katana: 0, bomb: 0, shield: 0 };

                // Init enemies
                enemies = enemyConfigs.map(function(cfg) {
                    return {
                        pos: cfg.pos,
                        icon: cfg.icon,
                        label: cfg.label,
                        defeated: false,
                        hp: 1,
                        maxHp: 1
                    };
                });

                scoreDisplay.textContent = '0';
                gameOverOverlay.classList.remove('active');
                shopOverlay.classList.remove('active');
                renderScene();
                renderQuestion();
                updateInventoryUI();
            }

            // ─── EVENT LISTENERS ──────────────────────────────────
            document.getElementById('btnQuit').onclick = function() {
                parent.postMessage({ type: 'quit' }, '*');
            };
            document.getElementById('btnBack').onclick = function() {
                parent.postMessage({ type: 'quit' }, '*');
            };
            document.getElementById('btnShop').onclick = openShop;
            document.getElementById('btnCloseShop').onclick = closeShop;
            document.getElementById('invBadge').onclick = openShop;

            // Close shop on overlay click
            shopOverlay.onclick = function(e) {
                if (e.target === shopOverlay) closeShop();
            };

            // ─── PARENT COMMUNICATION ─────────────────────────────
            window.addEventListener('message', function(e) {
                if (!e.data || !e.data.type) return;
                if (e.data.type === 'init') {
                    var d = e.data.data;
                    if (d && d.questions) {
                        initGame(d);
                    } else {
                        // Fallback with sample questions
                        var sample = {
                            questions: [{
                                id: 1,
                                content: 'Ninja thường sử dụng vũ khí gì?',
                                options: [
                                    { id: 1, content: 'Kiếm' },
                                    { id: 2, content: 'Súng' },
                                    { id: 3, content: 'Phi tiêu' },
                                    { id: 4, content: 'Rìu' }
                                ],
                                correctAnswerId: 1,
                                timeLimit: 15,
                                explanation: 'Ninja thường dùng phi tiêu (shuriken) làm vũ khí đặc trưng.'
                            }, {
                                id: 2,
                                content: 'Điều gì giúp ninja di chuyển nhanh?',
                                options: [
                                    { id: 1, content: 'Giày cao su' },
                                    { id: 2, content: 'Kỹ năng nhảy' },
                                    { id: 3, content: 'Áo choàng' },
                                    { id: 4, content: 'Giày leo núi' }
                                ],
                                correctAnswerId: 2,
                                timeLimit: 15,
                                explanation: 'Kỹ năng nhảy và di chuyển linh hoạt là điểm mạnh của ninja.'
                            }, {
                                id: 3,
                                content: 'Màu sắc nào thường gắn liền với ninja?',
                                options: [
                                    { id: 1, content: 'Đỏ' },
                                    { id: 2, content: 'Xanh' },
                                    { id: 3, content: 'Đen' },
                                    { id: 4, content: 'Trắng' }
                                ],
                                correctAnswerId: 3,
                                timeLimit: 15,
                                explanation: 'Ninja thường mặc đồ đen để ngụy trang trong bóng tối.'
                            }, {
                                id: 4,
                                content: 'Ninja thường tập luyện ở đâu?',
                                options: [
                                    { id: 1, content: 'Trong rừng' },
                                    { id: 2, content: 'Trên núi' },
                                    { id: 3, content: 'Trong thành phố' },
                                    { id: 4, content: 'Trên biển' }
                                ],
                                correctAnswerId: 2,
                                timeLimit: 15,
                                explanation: 'Ninja thường tập luyện ở vùng núi cao để rèn luyện thể lực.'
                            }, {
                                id: 5,
                                content: 'Vũ khí nào được ninja sử dụng để tấn công từ xa?',
                                options: [
                                    { id: 1, content: 'Kiếm' },
                                    { id: 2, content: 'Shuriken' },
                                    { id: 3, content: 'Rìu' },
                                    { id: 4, content: 'Gậy' }
                                ],
                                correctAnswerId: 2,
                                timeLimit: 15,
                                explanation: 'Shuriken (phi tiêu) là vũ khí tầm xa đặc trưng của ninja.'
                            }]
                        };
                        initGame(sample);
                    }
                }
            });

            parent.postMessage({ type: 'ready' }, '*');

            // ─── KEYBOARD SHORTCUT ──────────────────────────────
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    if (shopOverlay.classList.contains('active')) {
                        closeShop();
                    } else if (gameOverOverlay.classList.contains('active')) {
                        // ignore
                    }
                }
                if (e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '4') {
                    var idx = parseInt(e.key) - 1;
                    var btns = qOptions.querySelectorAll('.option-btn');
                    if (btns[idx] && !btns[idx].disabled) {
                        btns[idx].click();
                    }
                }
                if (e.key === 's' || e.key === 'S') {
                    openShop();
                }
            });

            console.log('🥷 Ninja game loaded! Use 1-4 to answer, S for shop.');
        })();
    </script>
</body>
